complete_available_job_description:
What Drives Success
We are seeking a highly motivated and innovative Mechanical Engineer to join our Advanced Technology Group, focusing on the commercial HVAC segment. This role involves developing and validating next-generation HVACR technologies with a focus on energy efficiency, sustainability, manufacturability, and regulatory compliance.
The ideal candidate will be passionate about emerging technologies, system-level design, and solving complex thermal and mechanical challenges.
DUTIES INCLUDE, BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO:
Lead and support the mechanical design, analysis, and prototyping of advanced HVACR components and systems (e.g., compressors, heat exchangers, fans, enclosures).
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (controls, electrical, materials, software) to develop integrated solutions.
Conduct feasibility studies, concept development, and performance simulations (CFD, FEA, thermodynamic models).
Evaluate new materials, design approaches, and processes to enhance product performance and manufacturability.
Develop and execute test plans for lab validation and performance characterization.
Participate in technical reviews, design for manufacturability (DFM), and risk assessment (FMEA).
Work closely with external research institutions, suppliers, and internal stakeholders to drive innovation.
Maintain awareness of industry trends, emerging technologies, and regulatory changes (e.g., low-GWP refrigerants, DOE standards).
Document technical work through reports, specifications, and intellectual property (patents, invention disclosures).
#LI-JM1 #LI-onsite
What We Are Looking For
Required:
Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering.
Experience with scientific programming (example: Python, VBA, EES, MATLAB, or C++).
Familiarity with HVACR system architecture and components.
Strong foundation in thermodynamics, heat transfer, and fluid mechanics.
Hands-on experience with prototyping, lab testing, and data analysis.
Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced R&D environment.
Effective communication and technical writing skills.
Preferred:
Master’s or Ph.D. in mechanical engineering.
Previous work experience in HVACR, thermal systems, or product development in a related industry.
Knowledge of low-GWP refrigerants, decarbonization strategies, and energy codes.
Patents or publications in relevant technical areas.
What We Offer
Compensation: This is a salaried exempt role. The starting salary range for this role and market is between $97,000 - $127,050 annually. Factors that may affect starting salary include geography/market and the skills, education, experience, and other qualifications of the successful candidate. This position is also eligible for the BroadBase Incentive (BBI) program with a target payout of 2%. Employees in this role are not eligible for overtime.
Location and Schedule: This position is located in Carrollton, TX and will be in the office Monday through Friday.
Benefits: Subject to applicable eligibility requirements, the following benefits are offered for this role: tuition reimbursement; medical, dental, and vision insurance; prescription drug coverage; 401(k) retirement plan; short-term disability insurance; 8 weeks paid birthing leave; 2 weeks paid bonding leave; life and long-term disability insurance.
Paid Time Off: Depending on date of hire, and subject to applicable eligibility requirements, new employees in this role also receive up to: 12 days paid time off, 2 paid well-being days, 1 paid volunteer day, 9 to 11 paid company holidays depending on the year, and 3 floating holidays per year.
Our Culture: At Lennox, our Core Values of Integrity, Respect & Excellence are ingrained in the fabric of the organization. They define our culture – which is about how we do business and how we treat others. Lennox is not just a workplace; we are a global community that values each team member’s contributions. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to recruit, develop, and retain talented individuals from a wide range of backgrounds, ensuring that everyone has the opportunity to succeed and contribute to our continued growth and success. At Lennox, you’ll take pride in our brands, knowing you are part of something special. Come, stay, and grow with us!
Disclaimers: The compensation and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. Lennox reserves the right to modify this information at any time, with or without notice, subject to applicable law. We may use automated tools, including artificial intelligence, to support parts of our hiring process, such as application review and interview scheduling. These tools assist our teams but do not replace human decision-making. If you need an accommodation or have questions, please contact CandidateAccommodations@Lennox.com.
Who We Are
Lennox (NYSE: LII) Driven by 130 years of legacy, HVAC and refrigeration success, Lennox provides our residential and commercial customers with industry-leading climate-control solutions. At Lennox, we win as a team, aiming for excellence and delivering innovative, sustainable products and services. Our culture guides us and creates a workplace where all employees feel heard and welcomed. Lennox is a global community that values each team member’s contributions and offers a supportive environment for career development. Come, stay, and grow with us.

source_jobposting_metadata.title: Advanced Technology Engineer

required_qualifications: Scientific programming experience; Python, VBA, EES, MATLAB or C++ are examples.
Familiarity with HVACR architectures and components.
Thermodynamics, heat transfer and fluid mechanics fundamentals.
Hands-on prototyping, laboratory testing and data analysis.
preferred_qualifications: HVACR, thermal-system or related product-development experience.
Low-GWP refrigerant, decarbonization and energy-code knowledge.

software_and_programming_requirements.interpretation: The posting lists programming examples rather than requiring every listed language. CFD and FEA are duties, without a named mandatory commercial package.

main_responsibilities: Develop mechanical concepts, analyses and prototypes for commercial HVACR components.
Simulate performance and validate designs experimentally.
Evaluate materials and manufacturability; participate in FMEA.
Collaborate across engineering disciplines and with suppliers/research institutions.
Track refrigerant/energy regulations and document specifications, research and intellectual property.

candidate_requirement_evidence.evidence: Python/CadQuery automation and real-time C/C++ HVAC numerical modeling are explicit. No need to claim VBA or EES.
Rheem condenser fan shroud, AHU, fan test fixture, condensate systems and mechanical assemblies are directly relevant.
Coupled heat-transfer/Navier-Stokes HVAC modeling plus CFD-driven product design and custom thermal-fluid solvers.
Fabricated and tested fan-shroud and AHU prototypes, developed adjustable fan fixtures and performed condensate experiments.
Motor-mount optimization and molding simplification; assembly FEA; documented polymer and sheet-metal analyses.

The mechanical PhD directly meets the preferred advanced-degree field. The documented bachelor’s is aeronautical engineering, while the required bachelor’s wording says mechanical engineering. Employer acceptance of this degree combination must be confirmed.
Numerous concurrent-design/research accomplishments support relevant project breadth; explicit scheduling/budget ownership and workload scope are not established.
Research publication contributions and submitted invention disclosures support technical dissemination; exact industry specification ownership is not established.
Current HVAC product-development work, thermal-fluid research and four submitted patent disclosures. Disclosures are not granted patents.

significant_candidate_qualification_gaps.detail: B.S. is aeronautical engineering; PhD is mechanical engineering. Do not relabel the bachelor’s. Confirm the employer accepts the combination.
Risk-assessment/FMEA duty is listed, but formal FMEA participation is not documented.

significant_candidate_qualification_gaps.requirement: Low-GWP refrigerants, decarbonization, energy codes and DOE regulations
significant_candidate_qualification_gaps.detail: Relevant HVAC exposure does not independently establish specific regulatory or refrigerant-selection expertise.
Research/client work provides related evidence; formal supplier management, project budgeting and independent multi-project management need confirmation.

match_score_note: Heuristic technical/location suitability, not hiring probability. Very close HVAC R&D, programming, FEA/CFD and prototype-validation match; discounted for exact undergraduate degree wording, FMEA and regulatory gaps.
recommendation_reasons: Matches documented recent HVAC R&D directly.
Dallas-area location meets the second geographic preference tier.
Combines scientific software, simulation and hands-on prototypes without requiring unverified named commercial solver expertise.
Mechanical PhD and invention-disclosure experience align with preferred qualifications and IP duties.

verification.status: Official role-specific page retrieved with HTTP 200 by direct download; official iframe page also read through web tool. Apply option present.
verification.closing_date_note: Structured validThrough is retained as employer-supplied metadata; it is not a guarantee of future availability.
verification.application_flow: Exact employer Apply link retained. Web tool could not fetch the application endpoint; no login or submission was performed.
verification.duplicate_check: Compared employer/requisition with existing SwRI 18-01598 and Synopsys 16469 folders. Not a duplicate of the previously unavailable Lennox 2025-50750 system-modeling role.

search_context.ranking_note: Selected the stronger direct HVAC R&D match over semiconductor software roles with parallel/GPU/domain gaps and SwRI experimental-mechanics roles with citizenship/specialized testing conditions.

candidate_source_notes: Current Rheem detailed source is EXP-001_Rheem_Project_Engineer_II_weighted_expanded.md; the older filename referenced by Candidate_profile.md is absent from libraries root.
Main experience, profile and software libraries reviewed. No master libraries were edited.
